answer: A decentralized AI economy achieves Sybil resistance by anchoring agent identities to verifiable computational stake rather than free network addresses. Each node must lock collateral behind a cryptographic falcon signature to participate in consensus across the network horizon. If an attacker attempts to spawn fraudulent agents to manipulate the system, the protocol isolates every malicious entity onto a severed economic island, immediately slashing their staked capital and rendering the attack economically unviable.
